source_caption_text:
Akon says Eminem treated making “Smack That” like a regular 9-to-5 job 😭🔥 He’d arrive at the studio at 9 a.m., take his lunch break at 1 p.m., and be out by 5, keeping a schedule even while creating one of the biggest songs of that era. 

Today marks 20 YEARS since Akon released “Konvicted,” the album that gave us “Smack That,” “I Wanna Love You,” “Don’t Matter,” and so many memories 🥹💿

“Smack That” brought Akon’s unmistakable hook together with Eminem’s verse and production, becoming a defining record from the project. The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100, while “Konvicted” also debuted at #2 on the Billboard 200.
